nodes.label: Handyman Harness Skill
nodes.rationale: A disk-backed operating layer where leader/implementer/reviewer work one feature at a time with executable verification, keeping multi-agent sessions auditable and resumable.

nodes.label: Disk As Source Of Truth
nodes.rationale: Resolving and persisting state on disk (feature_list.json, progress/, backlog reports) instead of chat makes agent work resumable and auditable across sessions.

nodes.label: Anti-Telefono-Descompuesto Pattern
nodes.rationale: Subagents write reports to files and the chat carries only short file references, preventing information loss across agent handoffs (the 'telephone game').

nodes.label: Local vs Global Install Scope
nodes.rationale: Local keeps mutable state in PROJECT_ROOT/.handyman so the repo root stays product-focused; global stores it under $HOME/HANDYMAN/<project_name>. Scope changes where state lives, not where agents live.
